annotation.interpretation_a: The pattern means that any codepoint where each nibble is a hexadecimal digit (i.e., any 32‑bit value) is reserved, so all codepoints are reserved.
annotation.interpretation_b: The pattern means that only codepoints matching the literal string "0x?a?a?a?a" (i.e., the four question marks are literal characters) are reserved, which would be a single, nonsensical codepoint.
annotation.justification: The clause uses an undefined pattern "0x?a?a?a?a" without defining the meaning of the question marks, allowing two materially different interpretations.
